title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Join the dynamic and collaborative team at Katalyst Data Management (KDM) KDM is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer - OCR with great problem-solving skills who is comfortable working with minimal supervision. This is an exciting opportunity to play an integral role in achieving the company's goals. Qualified candidates will bring a strong knowledge of supervised image classification and open-source technologies to help us address our customer's needs.

  • Located in Barra da Tijuca, Brazil
  • Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., (occasional extended hours to support deployments or maintain service continuity)
  • Full-Time position

The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) is the global leader in hosted subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification, to data storage and organisation, to marketing data online, our specialised data services cater to large multinational corporations, national governments and small independents. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment has enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Own the platform, elevate the velocity. The DevOps Engineer is at the center of designing and running our next‑gen hybrid infrastructure, orchestrating application and service migrations to Kubernetes across AWS EKS and on‑prem environments—driving performance, security, and resilience. Partnering closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Software Engineering teams, you'll architect and automate deployments end‑to‑end, lead initiatives that expand our container orchestration, modernize CI/CD pipelines, and standardize provisioning with infrastructure‑as‑code. If you thrive on building scalable platforms that ship faster and safer, this is the role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, deploy, and manage Kubernetes clusters across AWS EKS and on-premises environments.
  • Lead migration efforts from AWS ECS to EKS and on-prem Kubernetes platforms.
  • Develop and maintain Terraform modules for infrastructure provisioning and configuration.
  • Implement, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
  • Apply security best practices for containerized applications and Kubernetes cluster configurations.
  • Collaborate with development teams to define standardized application deployment workflows.
  • Monitor system performance and reliability, troubleshoot, and resolve complex infrastructure issues.
  • Contribute to the creation of operational documentation and automate routine tasks to minimize manual intervention.

Knowledge & Skills Required:

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes administration and full cluster lifecycle management.
  • Proficiency in Terraform for implementing Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong background in CI/CD pipeline design and Git-based workflows.
  • Deep understanding of Docker and containerized application architectures.
  • Solid grasp of networking fundamentals, including DNS, routing, load balancing, ingress.
  • Familiarity with observability tools and stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, and Open Telemetry.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex distributed systems and deployment environments effectively.
  • English – Intermediate level – capacity to keep oral conversation with native speakers.

Required Education and Experience:

  1. Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  2. 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or a similar role.
  3. Proven expertise in managing Kubernetes clusters on a scale, both in cloud and on-premises environments.
  4. Hands-on experience implementing Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is a full-time position. As a full-time position, the DevOps Engineer is eligible to participate in benefits coverage offered to Katalyst employees based on geographical location.

Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with occasional extended hours to support deployments or maintain service continuity.

Hybrid work model – three remote days and two on-site days per week.

Travel:

Minimal travel may be required for on-premises infrastructure support, implementation, or occasional team collaboration. If participation in an offsite meeting is requested, all related travel expenses will be covered or reimbursed, in accordance with the company's policies and local regulations.

Titulo da Vaga – Recepcionista

Atender pacientes e familiares de forma empática e humanizada, realizando sua identificação de forma segura e acompanhando-o para o seu destino final.   • Analisar agendas do dia e realizar a conferência das autorizações X exames agendados X pedido médico, bem como a validade da autorização e ao final do dia e as faltas;
  • Visualizar a lista de espera do sistema TINC PAGER e chamar o paciente de acordo com o horário de agendamento dos exames e ao final do atendimento recolher o pager;
  • Atender o paciente, realizar ou conferir cadastro com as informações dos seus documentos;
  • Gerar atendimento em sistema e coletar assinatura nos documentos internos do hospital e guias dos convênios;
  • No caso de atendimentos particulares, realizar os recebimentos dos valores em sistema, de acordo com o exame a ser realizado;
  • Realizar fechamento do caixa, incluindo quitação das contas, finalização da máquina de cartão, fechamento de lote e emissão de NF;
  • Observar as particularidades de cada convênio e exame, conforme informações disponibilizadas no Manual de Agendamento;
  • Solicitar preenchimento de todos os termos relacionados aos exames que o paciente irá realizar.
  • Escanear os documentos em anexar em sistema conforme rotina;
  • Encaminhar documentos internos para os seus destinos, conforme rotina;
  • Acompanhar o paciente até a sala de espera do exame;
  • Realizar a internação de pacientes;
  • Solicitar autorização dos exames;
  • Realizar a aplicação do Termo de Responsabilidade Financeira no leito do paciente, inclusive terapia intensiva, quarto ou leito de isolamento;
  • Realizar agendamentos presenciais, bem como as remarcações;
  • Entrar em contato com os pacientes informando sobre atrasos;
  • Realizar a entrega dos exames de imagem pessoalmente aos pacientes;
  • Realizar o MOVDOC de documentos sm sistema, conforme rotina;
  • Receber amostras de materiais e direcionar conforme rotina;
  • Solicitar autorização para os exames solicitados;
  • Disponibilizar laudos conforme solicitação;
  • Digitalizar e arquivar documentos e termos de atendimentos, em pastas de rede e sistema (MV/ Carestream)
  • Zelar pela ordem do ambiente e do serviço em geral.
  • Abrir chamados para solicitações à TI e infraestrutura, sempre que houver necessidade;
  • Render as demais recepções nos horários de descanso e sempre que necessário

Salário:

Local:

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
About Us

Talent is our World.

At AMS, we believe in nurturing talent and fostering a culture where passion for success thrives. As part of our commitment to your growth and development, we encourage you to explore opportunities available within our organization. Your talent is our greatest asset, and we're dedicated to providing avenues for you to reach its fullest potential. We do so by providing the environment, resources, networks, and career experiences essential for your progress.

Take the next step in your career journey and discover our exciting opportunities.

The Role

Hybrid role, working from our client's office in either Rio de Janeiro or Macaé, Brazil.

Would you be interested in being a vital part of a team to secure top talent for our client? Then let's talk

In this role, you will support client hiring managers with filling their vacancies to target start dates, ensuring all quality thresholds and SLA/KPIs are met. They will deliver excellent recruitment services to the client in line with agreed service levels, acting as the custodian of candidate quality and the hiring manager experience.

They will use a range of data led sourcing insights to determine the best hiring strategy for each requisition, leveraging data, historic hiring trends, and market analysis to find the best talent in the market.

You will be aligned to high-touch client business units or stakeholder groups that require additional attention, this includes more challenging or senior stakeholder group, more complex or hard to fill role types, roles that have a greater strategic significance.

Key Accountabilities

What you'll be doing:

Recruitment Delivery:

  • Execute candidate sourcing and attraction plan including engaging candidates from known talent pools (Internal ATS/ CRM Alumni pools etc.)
  • Ensure recruitment services meet contractual obligations and client SLAs.
  • Lead hiring strategy meetings to agree on recruitment plans with hiring managers.
  • Use data led sourcing insights to determine the best hiring strategy for each requisition, leveraging data, historic hiring trends, and market analysis
  • Review CVs and compliantly and comprehensively screen candidates to present quality shortlisted candidates to hiring managers, coaching the managers through their candidate selection decisions at shortlist & interview
  • Deliver excellent candidate experience from first contact through interview process to start date.
  • Drive hiring decisions and lead offer negotiations.
  • Address potential stakeholder issues and share knowledge to enhance recruitment delivery.
  • Support defined future hiring requirements by talent pooling relevant quality candidates.

Technology and Compliance:

  • Track candidate status and requisition updates in relevant systems.
  • Identify and flag scope creep for account contractual management.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant legislation and track compliance risks

Client Stakeholder Relationships:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior hiring managers/stakeholders. (see role purpose for description of types of stakeholders)

Internal Stakeholder Relationships:

  • Collaborate with Talent Sourcing, Insights, Talent Attraction, and Administration teams for a smooth client and candidate experience.

Skills & Experience

You'll need to demonstrate:

  • Proven
    end-to-end recruitment delivery experience
    , ideally within the
    Oil & Gas industry
    .
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese
    ; proficiency in
    Spanish
    is a strong advantage.
  • Solid understanding of
    talent attraction and sourcing strategies
    , including web sourcing, networking, advertising, and database searching.
  • Hands-on experience using
    Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)
    —
    Workday
    experience preferred.
  • Good knowledge of
    employment legislation
    relevant to the role (e.g., age discrimination, contractor compliance, OFCCP regulations).
  • Strong
    stakeholder management
    and
    communication skills
    , with the ability to partner effectively with recruiters, hiring managers, and HR teams.
  • Exceptional
    attention to detail
    and
    organizational skills
    , ensuring accuracy and compliance across all recruitment documentation and workflows.
  • Ability to
    prioritize and manage multiple requisitions and deadlines
    , demonstrating ownership, accountability, and a results-driven approach throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

Other

Every one of us plays a pivotal role in our success, whether engaging directly with clients or shaping the value we add behind the scenes. Together, it means more insight and expertise for our clients and more exciting career paths and experiences for us.

Apart from our benefits package, you'll also get to enjoy the flexibility, autonomy, and trust to work in a way that works best for you. We just focus on providing the means to meet, collaborate, and support each other however you choose.

We offer:

  • Full training and support
  • High value and challenging work
  • A vibrant, diverse, and collaborative culture
  • Flexible working
  • A competitive reward and benefits package*
  • The opportunity to embark on a recruitment career with one of the world's leading recruitment companies

*Details may vary slightly depending on your location, local labor law, etc.

Our culture of inclusion and belonging.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, and all aspects of employment are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate based upon age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.

If you require any accommodations or have any accessibility needs, please reach out via email or make a member of our Talent Acquisition team aware at any time.

title: instrumentador cirúrgico
description:
CENTRO DO OLHO CARIOCA está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  • diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;
  • realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;
  • avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;
  • programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;
  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar junto à equipe cirúrgica, se responsabilizando pela organização, quantidade e qualidade do funcionamento do instrumental e de equipamentos a serem utilizados pela equipe cirúrgica, estando atento a controle de reposição e devolução.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Completo
  • Curso Completo de Técnico de Enfermagem e Instrumentação Cirúrgica
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Experiência mínima de 06 meses comprovada na função de Instrumentador Cirúrgico

Informações adicionais

  • Disponibilidade para atuar na escala 12X36.
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão


A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

title: Mechanical Supervisor
description:
*JOB DESCRIPTION *
Responsible for /ensure:

  • All relevant governing documents are adhered to by direct reports.
  • All relevant governing documents are revised as and when required.
  • That clear daily guidelines are provided to all direct reports.
  • Visible leadership by spending time in the field and monitoring daily operations.
  • Required logbooks are maintained and updated as per requirements.
  • Thorough handovers are provided at each daily change of shift.
  • Subordinates are trained to fill higher positions .

Other duties are performed as required and/or directed by his/her direct supervisor.
EQUIPMENT & SYSTEMS
Responsible For /ensure:

  • Operational preparedness of all safety and emergency equipment.
  • That all relevant equipment is maintained and maintenance is recorded.
  • Sufficient stock of spare parts and materials required is maintained.

*Responsabilities
RESPONSIBILITIES *

  • Ensure effective use of the Company's Maintenance Management System.
  • Ensure that personnel complete tasks in a safe and efficient manner and comply with all Company policies and regulatory laws and regulations.
  • Assist in planning and coordinating all preventative and corrective maintenance activities in conjunction with other department heads.
  • Assists the Technical Section Leader with all certificates for Class, Flag State and regulatory body requirements.
  • Work with Technical Section Leader and other supervisors to coordinate daily work activities accordingly.
  • Assist the Technical Section Leader to ensure that all Third Party equipment is fit for purpose, certified,
  • correctly installed and maintained while on the rig.
  • Ensure that reports for repair and maintenance of equipment are accurate and complete.
  • Ensure that the permit to work and isolation systems are strictly adhered to by the maintenance department.
  • Assist the drilling department with repair and maintenance of drilling equipment as required.
  • Perform maintenance of all the unit's systems including the piping system according to the maintenance program.
  • Assist the electrical department with repair and maintenance of electrical equipment as required.
  • Ensure technical inventory is maintained within budget and at operating levels.
  • Ensure equipment is maintained as per Seadrill and manufacturer's specifications.
  • Assist other departments to ensure first line maintenance is performed effectively.
  • Develop and promote effective troubleshooting condition evaluation and root cause failure analysis programs for all technical equipment.
  • Promote and develop maintenance task optimization and provide feedback to technical team. Follow up and implement approved changed to SAMS.
  • Maintain a working relationship with the Client representatives.
  • Perform or lead incident investigation as required.
  • Ensure technical inventory is maintained within budget and at operating levels
  • Assist with coordinating management of change for design modification of equipment and within technical area;
  • Liaise with shore based technical staff to ensure a timely transfer of knowledge within the fleet.
  • Liaise with the marine department regarding the loading, ordering and use of fuel, lubes, potable water and drill water.
  • Assist with classification surveys as part of continuous machinery survey and any other applicable requirements.
  • Assist Technical Section Leader with budget preparation.
  • Mentor, develop and train crew members to ensure they are competent to work in their current job positions and where appropriate coached and prepared for the next position.
  • Ensure that approved rig operating procedures are adhered to at all times. Report all unsafe activities, situations, and potential hazards to supervisor.
  • Actively participate in safety, departmental, pre-tour, client meetings, etc.
  • Actively participate in the Safety Management Systems.
  • Ensure housekeeping is maintained in assigned areas.
  • Effectively use all safety and environmental tools employed by Seadrill (5-point check, STAR cards, PTW etc.).
  • Perform all emergency duties as per designation on the station bill and emergency response plans.
  • Comply with the training matrix for the position.
  • Comply with the Competence Assurance Program in a timely manner as per Seadrill requirement.
  • Conduct performance appraisals for subordinates. Recommend promotion, development or disciplinary action.
  • Follow maintenance policy as specified by the Company at all times.
  • Review and, as required, perform all safety control duties as per rig´s specific HSE Case, Safety Case, HAZOP and TBRA´s.
  • Review and, as required, perform all duties related to safety controls among all tasks performed by himself and or working group.
  • Perform, respecting any applicable license limitation and under supervision, similar responsibilities as the Technical Leader, Engine Room Operator or Assistant Technical Section Leader for training, qualification and temporary coverage purposes.
  • Perform, if required, the same duties as senior mechanic.

*QUALIFICATIONS *
As per Seadrill training and competence directives.

*Minimum Requirements For The Role: *

  • Be able to communicate both in Portuguese and English
  • High School Technical diploma in Mechanic with professional register valid (CFT Ativo)
  • Previous experience within the function
  • Previous experience in Drilling Companies
  • Valid certificates: CBSP, THUET, NR13, etc.

SAFETY AT SEADRILL
Our goal is to ensure that 'nobody gets hurt' whilst performing their job. Everyone at Seadrill has a part to play in meeting our safety commitment.

Through strong leadership and personal responsibility from all employees, we take a systematic approach to identifying, managing and preventing the hazards involved in our day to day operations.

Everyone at Seadrill is accountable for helping to build this culture of care. This includes:

In Seadrill, Setting The Standard Is Not Just About What We Deliver, But How We Deliver It. title: Analista de Conteúdo
description:
Aqui no LIV, entendemos que os sentimentos são partes essenciais para a aprendizagem, por isso, a nossa missão é criar espaços de escuta e fala que ampliem a compreensão de si, do outro e do mundo, promovendo um aprendizado socioemocional de qualidade para todos. Para isso, buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com o nosso propósito e compartilhem da nossa vontade de espalhar o Jeito LIV, impactando as comunidades escolares de todo o Brasil.

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Conteúdo que seja proativo(a), criativo(a), que goste de trabalhar em equipe, ame educação e tenha facilidade de escrita para ser parte da equipe de desenvolvimento de criação de conteúdo pedagógico e material didático do LIV

E aí, #VemSerLIVástico com a gente?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar da elaboração e construção dos materiais e recursos pedagógicos (educação socioemocional);
  • Produção de material didático para a Educação básica (educação infantil ao ensino médio);
  • Revisão do material escrito visando melhor impactar o nosso público a partir de pesquisa e feedback;
  • Participar de reuniões de equipe e de criação de projetos;
  • Realizar pesquisas com professores, alunos e gestores;
  • Acompanhar palestras e formações;
  • Conduzir dinâmicas com equipes internas e externas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em psicologia, pedagogia, licenciaturas ou demais graduações ligadas a área da Educação;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar 40 horas semanais (contratação CLT), no modelo híbrido (nosso escritório fica em Botafogo, no Rio de Janeiro);
  • Ter facilidade para produzir textos que dialogue com diversos públicos (alunos, professores e gestores);
  • Ser criativo na elaboração de dinâmicas e atividades do universo de Educação Socioemocional;
  • Ser responsável no cumprimento de prazos e processos burocráticos da empresa;
  • Ser colaborativo e disponível para aprendizagem.

Não é essencial, mas vamos amar se você tiver:

  • Alguma especialização ou experiência na área de Educação/Psicologia/Educação Midiática;
  • Experiência na elaboração de material didático;
  • Familiaridade com dados e/ou processos de pesquisa;
  • Experiência em sala de aula.

Informações adicionais

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e o Brasil. Assim, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas que se identifiquem com grupos minorizados em todas as nossas posições.

Não podemos escolher o que sentimos, mas podemos aprender o que fazer com nossos sentimentos. Já pensou nisso?

Prazer, somos o Laboratório Inteligência de Vida, mas pode chamar de LIV Entendemos que os sentimentos são partes essenciais para a aprendizagem, por isso, a nossa missão é criar espaços de escuta e fala que ampliem a compreensão de si, do outro e do mundo, promovendo um aprendizado socioemocional de qualidade para todos.

Para isso, buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com o nosso propósito e compartilhem da nossa vontade de espalhar o jeito LIV, impactando as comunidades escolares de todo o Brasil.

Vem com a gente nessa jornada?

Aqui você vai encontrar:

Pessoas colaborativas - Acreditamos que juntos somos capazes de encontrar as melhores soluções;

Crescimento com responsabilidade e propósito - Reconhecemos que a ética e o impacto pedagógico são inegociáveis no nosso dia a dia;

Cuidado e escuta com quem faz o LIV - Valorizamos o cuidado e o respeito como partes imprescindíveis do nosso trabalho, por isso somos empáticos e acolhedores;

Visão em movimento - Somos inquietos, propositivos e inovamos para entregar a melhor experiência socioemocional;

Compromisso com a nossa comunidade - Tomamos decisões a partir do que as nossas escolas têm a dizer, praticando a escuta ativa e a cultura de feedbacks.

title: Especialista Contábil
description:

  • Fazer a interface com a Contabilidade Externa contratada, prezando pelo cumprimento dos prazos;
  • Realizar planejamento tributário, otimizando isenções (IR, INSS, etc.) e imunidades para entidades de Terceiro Setor;
  • Analisar os lançamentos sistêmicos, verificando e orientando os centros de custo e grupos de pagamento para proporcionar Demonstrações Financeiras corretas;
  • Analisar as Demonstrações Financeiras das filiais e matriz após a entrega pela Contabilidade Externa e gerar relatórios das diferenças anuais;
  • Acompanhar os cronogramas e as entregas das obrigações acessórias como ECF, ECD, DIRF, EFD, DCTFWeb, eSocial e prestações de contas a doadores e órgãos públicos;
  • Colaborar junto à Contabilidade Externa nas soluções contábeis para o Instituto, acerca das formas de contratação de prestadores de serviço, recebimento de patrocínios e doações, objetivando menor carga tributária, entre demais soluções;
  • Desenvolver novos fluxos e controles que sejam necessários, a fim de automatizar as e sistematizar tudo o que for possível, sempre garantindo a segurança financeira do Instituto e seus equipamentos;
  • Grande interface com a área Financeira;
  • Responsável pelo processo de Auditoria externa anual, apoiando a Gerência Geral no processo de contratação da Auditoria externa, análise da minuta de contrato e Contabilidade externa, sendo interlocutor(a) com as demais áreas demandadas;
  • Responsável pela Auditoria interna, caso haja;
  • Apoiar nas demandas de prestações de contas;
  • Responsável pela Contabilidade externa, controlando o prazo de vigência do contrato, atuando diretamente no processo de contratação/renovação da Contabilidade externa, análise da minuta de contrato da Contabilidade externa, sendo interlocutor(a) com as demais áreas;
  • Controlar o Patrimônio verificando físico (interface com a área de Suprimentos) x Sistema ERP;
  • Desenvolver/emitir relatórios pertinentes à área, que apoiem a Diretoria na tomada de decisões.

O que é necessário para esta posição:

  • Graduação completa em em Ciências Contábeis, com CRC ativo;
  • Conhecimentos em Legislação Tributária e Fiscal;
  • Domínio de NBC ITG 2002, planejamento tributário para sem fins lucrativos, custeio por projetos e normas como Lei 9.532/97 e 12.101/09;
  • Conhecimentos de Leis que regem o Terceiro Setor;
  • Conhecimento comprovado dos princípios, práticas e padrões contábeis.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Result of Service

The Administrative Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Expected duration

2 months, with the possibility of renewal

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners, for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. UN-Habitat and the Instituto Pereira Passos/Municipality of Rio de Janeiro have a longstanding collaboration and are currently implementing the Social Territories Programme in the city. To support the effective implementation of this initiative, the UN-Habitat Office in Rio de Janeiro is looking for an Administrative Assistant. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Administrative Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Administrative Assistant will support the implementation of the programme and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Provide administrative support to implement project-related activities. b) Support the project team's communication with local counterparts and partners, such as local governments, civil society organizations, universities, private sector, etc. c) Support the adequate execution of technical and/or administrative activities of the project, under the guidelines of immediate supervisor. d) Organize project meetings and document group meetings, forums, consultations, training events and other activities related to project planning, development, and implementation. e) Support in the collection of data, legislation and other documents in the municipal offices and archives. f) Organize and archive all documents and information relevant to project administration. g) Support the receipt and distribution of correspondence, materials, and equipment. h) Support the team through audits and other administrative and financial compliance checks. i) Maintain and update office inventory. j) Request quotes for low-value acquisitions. k) Write official letters in Portuguese. l) Support the selection processes of technical and/or field personnel, schedule and organize interview panels, contact shortlisted candidates for interviews and provide post-interview feedback if necessary. m) Assist in receiving monthly reports from consultants and/or field staff, including the procedures necessary for the monthly payroll. n) Assist in the organization of events (in-person or online), including registration forms, attendance lists, issuing certificates, booking venues and coffee breaks, and other necessary operational activities. o) Assist with travel requests for the technical team, including travel requests and mission reports. p) Be responsible for keeping information organized and accessible. q) Carry out specific activities and other tasks that may be requested by the supervisor. r) Support other administrative functions as requested by the UN-Habitat operational team in Rio de Janeiro. s) Participate in missions as requested. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Administrative Assistant will support the implementation of a project in partnership with the above-mentioned institution. The Administrative Assistant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil of monthly activities' report.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Administration, International Relations, Public Management or related fields, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
• Minimum two (2) years of experience in administrative, secretarial, project management, operational and/or human resources activities is required.
• Professional experience with local governments and/or civil society and advocacy initiatives is desirable.
• Previous experience in the United Nations System is desirable.
• Familiarity with and interest in urban development and climate issues as well as the Organization's global urban agenda is desirable. Skills:
• Proficiency in Office Package (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook) is required.
• Mastery of technological tools and use of software and online platforms is required.
• Mastery of online event and conference tools is desirable.
• Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages

  • English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office. For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of any other working language of the United Nations is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration SB-3/1 UNDP Brazil Salary Scale. Notes Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted in the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Applications should be submitted through INSPIRA and must include all documents required at the system, please be ready to include the following information at the "Candidate Profile" (CP) at Inspira:
• Cover memo (maximum 1 page)
• Educational Background (incl. dates)
• Professional Experience (assignments, tasks, achievements, duration by years/ months)
• Expertise and preferences regarding location of potential assignments
• Other Experience and Expertise (e.g. Internships/voluntary work, etc.) * * Please note that Internships, self-employment and part-time count as 50%. In addition to it, note experience not relevant to the position will not be considered. All applications should be submitted to: Inspira UN-HABITAT does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process. If you have any questions concerning people or companies claiming to be recruiting on behalf of these offices and requesting the payment of a fee, please contact:

No Fee

THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CHARGE A FEE AT ANY STAGE OF THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS (APPLICATION, INTERVIEW MEETING, PROCESSING, OR TRAINING). THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CONCERN ITSELF WITH INFORMATION ON APPLICANTS' BANK ACCOUNTS.

A Pandora é pioneira no setor, sendo a primeira joalheria do mundo a utilizar produtos 100% reciclados. Com um compromisso firme com a sustentabilidade, cada peça não é apenas uma joia, mas uma celebração do estilo e da consciência ambiental.

Na PANDORA, somos guiados por quatro valores:

We Dream (Sonhamos), somos visionários e vamos além do óbvio. We Dare (Ousamos) perseguir ambições ousadas com coragem e rapidez. We Care (Cuidamos) nós nos preocupamos profundamente uns com os outros, com nossos clientes e com o planeta que todos compartilhamos. Todos os dias nos esforçamos para ser um local de trabalho gratificante, onde cada um de nós pode prosperar e contribuir, onde os talentos podem crescer e cumprimos nossas promessas a colegas, clientes, parceiros e partes interessadas - We Deliver (entregamos).

title: Implementations Lead
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve


As the Rio Implementations Lead, you will bridge the gap between technical execution and local team leadership. You will become an expert in private markets data and use that knowledge to implement our clients onto the Carta LPPA software, setting them up for long-term success.

As a technical specialist, you will: Directly interact with clients, managing implementation projects from post-sale requirements gathering to final system setup.

  • Extract the first tranches of data from documents and hand them off to the LPPA MDS team or the clients directly.
  • Train clients remotely over video conferencing and answer technical questions regarding LPPA software and setup via email or quick calls.
  • Establish strong customer relationships as the first post-sale service provider, inspiring long-term loyalty through a smooth onboarding process.
  • Work comfortably with data and business systems to develop training content for customers.
  • Think creatively to find software solutions for both equity and user problems.

As the local lead and future manager, you will be responsible for HR-based initiatives, including:

  • Overseeing onboarding, learning, and development for the local team.
  • Encouraging career growth and performance from both a professional and metrics-driven perspective.
  • Reviewing team and individual performance metrics to provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Leading the execution of strategic initiatives, such as new processes, systems, and tools across the local department.
  • Collaborating cross-functionally to identify customer pain points and provide product improvement recommendations to ensure a "magical" customer experience.

The Team You'll Join


You will be the first service provider post-sale, joining a high-growth environment where you will eventually lead a team of Support Analysts and Specialists. You will work closely with product, engineering, and internal implementations leaders to constantly improve the onboarding experience and service models for new customer types.

About You

  • Communication: Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to articulate complex concepts clearly.
  • Organization: Highly organized with extreme attention to detail, capable of balancing multiple active projects with competing priorities.
  • Client-Centric: You care deeply about client services and exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise when communicating with customers under pressure.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in Excel and experienced with CRMs (preferably Salesforce).
  • Analytical Mindset: Able to independently identify problems, perform root cause analysis, and execute action plans.
  • Adaptability: Flexible, resilient, and comfortable dealing with uncertainties or ambiguous situations.
  • Leadership Traits: Proactive, ambitious, and a self-starter who takes ownership and empowers teammates to improve.
  • Experience (Plus): Knowledge of finance and accounting, or experience working at a high-growth software company.

Ao longo dos anos, ampliamos nossa oferta de produtos, e hoje possuímos mais de 20 departamentos, garantindo que nossos clientes encontrem tudo o que precisam em um só lugar. Com um estoque robusto de mais de 9.500 itens, nossa equipe comercial está sempre pronta para atender às demandas do mercado com agilidade e eficiência.

Trabalhamos com mais de 270 marcas renomadas, cuidadosamente selecionadas para garantir a melhor qualidade e variedade aos nossos clientes. Essas parcerias com marcas de prestígio nos permitem oferecer produtos confiáveis, certificados e inovadores, que atendem às mais diversas necessidades do setor de construção.

Nosso compromisso com a excelência se estende à nossa logística. Com uma área de armazenagem de 14.000m², operamos com um alto nível de organização e capacidade de resposta. Nossa operação eficiente e bem estruturada nos permite atender todo o estado do Rio de Janeiro, garantindo que nossos clientes recebam seus pedidos de forma rápida e segura. Nossa equipe dedicada e altamente capacitada está sempre pronta para oferecer um serviço de alta qualidade, priorizando a satisfação dos nossos clientes em cada etapa do processo.

Na BONI, acreditamos que construir parcerias sólidas é fundamental para o sucesso. Por isso, trabalhamos diariamente para entregar qualidade em tudo o que fazemos.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para o cargo de auxiliar de conferente na Nova Boni, localizado em Rio de Janeiro, RJ. As principais atividades incluem a conferência de produtos e mercadorias, separação, organização do estoque, arrumação dos materiais e controle de entrada e saída de itens. Será responsável por verificar a integridade e a conformidade das mercadorias, assegurando que estejam de acordo com os pedidos. Este é um cargo presencial.

title: IT Support Technician
description:
IT Support Technician

  • Located in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Full Time Position, Monday - Friday

The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The IT Support Technician provides basic technical support to the Brazil business unit. This role focuses on assisting with day-to-day IT operations, including troubleshooting hardware and software issues, supporting user access, and maintaining system functionality. The position works under the guidance of senior IT staff and collaborates with local teams to ensure smooth IT operations. The role reports directly to the Director of IT and maintains a functional reporting line to the Operations Manager.

Tasks:

  1. Perform basic troubleshooting with the ability to resolve common hardware and software issues for desktops, laptops, printers, and peripheral devices.
  2. Provide user support by assisting with password resets, account lockouts, and VPN connectivity issues.
  3. Monitor system performance and report issues to senior IT staff and via applicable Remedy Ticket Systems.
  4. Assist with software installations and updates of standard applications under supervision.
  5. Provide inventory & setup by preparing new workstations and ensuring proper configuration.
  6. Maintain records of support requests and resolutions.
  7. Perform simple maintenance tasks like cleaning equipment and checking cables.

Skills:

  • Proficient oral and written communication skills in both Portuguese and English.
  • Basic knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (IP addresses, Wi-Fi setup).
  • Ability to follow instructions and escalate complex issues.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This role does not include supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment:

This position is based in a professional office setting and involves regular use of standard office equipment, including computers and phones. Additionally, the role may occasionally require interaction with enterprise-grade IT and infrastructure systems such as firewalls, network switches, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), and both copper and fiber optic network cabling under the supervision of Senior IT staff.

Physical Demands:

This is an active, hands-on role that requires the IT Support Technician to spend a significant portion of the day standing and moving. The position may involve short bursts of physically demanding activity, such as lifting and relocating computer equipment or navigating stairs. On occasion, tasks may require working in confined or elevated spaces, including under raised computer room floors or above drop ceilings.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is a full-time role, and as such, the IT Support Technician is eligible to participate in the regional benefits program available to Katalyst employees.

Core working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Additional hours, including occasional night, weekend, and holiday work, may be required to fulfill job responsibilities and support operational needs.

Travel:

Occasional travel may be necessary. Mileage for offsite meetings or errands will be reimbursed at the current regional rate. Travel will mostly be within the Rio De Janeiro area visiting client and 3
rd
 party sites to service our equipment located at those sites.

Required Education and Experience

  • Certificate of Completion of Secondary Education
  • IT-related coursework, professional training, or industry certifications preferred.
  • Experience of up to 2 years in IT support, system administration, or networking (including internships or technical school experience).
  • Working proficiency in English.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications:

None required.

Other Duties:

Please note, this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employer for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical depth, collaboration, and systems thinking shape the future of subsea developments?
Would you bring the curiosity, adaptability, and engineering mindset needed to solve complex challenges in early-phase offshore projects?
Join our Subsea & Surface Pressure Systems Team
Bringing cutting-edge physical and digital technologies together to create subsea systems the beating heart of our work. Devising smarter systems that control and monitor oil and gas extraction, our subsea products and flexible pipe capabilities are industry leading. Our team provides support for customer operations to ensure continuity for production.

Partner with the best
As a Subsea Systems Engineer, you will be challenged to lead Front End Engineering & Development studies, where you will give support to projects and support technology development at a system coordination level. You will also support execution of subsea projects. You will be supporting the regional sales and commercial teams, interacting with Customers providing technical expertise during early engagement activities.

As a Subsea Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Executing System design to proposals and projects.
  • Reporting of progress, technical and interface matters in project meetings and progress reports of assigned tasks and CTRs.
  • Defining system layout from concept definition phase to FEED, detail engineering and execution phases of a subsea project.
  • Defining and preparing functional specifications for subsea system building blocks such as Trees, Controls, Wellhead connections, Manifolds, and Flowlines.
  • Acting or supporting the study manager with technical interface, change control, technical variations, and general delivery of the scope.
  • Providing system design input to large subsea project proposals and equipment contracts.
  • Liaising with clients on a technical level to ensure their needs are being met and ensuring they are aware of the data input requirements to allow the study to proceed on-schedule.
  • Supporting the OFE sales and commercial organization in identifying and pursuing opportunities related to early engagement or invitations to tender.
  • Assisting in the preparation of proposals as part of a proposals team or technical peer checker.

Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a MSc or BSc degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Controls Engineering or equivalent as required with extensive experience in a similar role.
  • Have broad knowledge of processes, methods and procedures within project and engineering management.
  • Have proven experience in front-end design activities, covering concept, pre-FEED and FEED studies.
  • Have proven experience in design and selection across one or more of the following: Field architecture / Flow assurance / System Analysis / Interface Management / Requirement Management / Process engineering / Subsea Production Systems / Risers, flowlines and pipelines / Control systems / Constructability and installation.
  • Have demonstrable depth of experience in project engineering within a multi-disciplinary environment.
  • Be available to travel internationally for project needs and for short term assignments.

Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - from 7am-4pm
  • Location: RETIC, Ilha do Fundão, Rio de Janeiro.

Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us:
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us:
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you Let's come together and take energy forward.

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

  • Located in Barra da Tijuca, Brazil
  • 30 Hours Per Week - Monday - Friday

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Build software that powers real‑world decisions. As a Software Development Intern, you'll contribute to production web applications across the stack—.NET Core and Python on the back end, React and jQuery on the front end—inside a collaborative culture that prizes innovation, performance, and scalability. Expect structured mentorship, meaningful ownership, and hands‑on experience with projects ranging from spatial data tools to specialized oil & gas solutions—think seismic and well data visualization/manipulation and web‑scraping pipelines—where advanced technology meets complex business challenges. If you're ready to learn fast, ship fast, and see your work make an impact, this is the opportunity.

Tasks:

  • Work with the development team to design, build, and maintain features across company applications using SQL, Java, .NET, Python, and JavaScript—leveraging frameworks such as React and jQuery.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Analytical thinking – ability to break down problems into smaller components.
  • Understanding of algorithms – basic concepts like loops, conditionals, and data structures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is an internship position with a workload of 6 hours per day, totaling 30 hours per week.

Activities may be performed at Katalyst's office or remotely, depending on availability and team coordination.

The work schedule is flexible within regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.), while respecting the 6-hour daily requirement.

Hybrid work model – three remote days and two on-site days per week.

Travel:

This position does not require travel. All work will be conducted in-office or virtually. If participation in an offsite meeting or company event is ever requested, Katalyst will cover or reimburse all related expenses in accordance with company policies and local regulations.

Required Education and Experience

Currently enrolled in a technology-related undergraduate program with at least one year remaining before graduation.

Mais do que uma empresa de engenharia, a SANDECH se posiciona como um parceiro estratégico de seus clientes, unindo experiência técnica, inovação e qualidade. Em constante crescimento, buscamos profissionais comprometidos com a excelência e com a construção de soluções cada vez mais eficientes e sustentáveis para a indústria brasileira.

  • Apoiar análises básicas de custos, comparativos de preços e relatórios de compras para controle e tomada de decisão;

title: AZZAS 2154 | Grupo Soma | Labs | Pessoa Desenvolvedora Mobile Flutter Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Inquietos e Acelerados. Criativos ou Cartesianos. Talentosos e Autodidatas. Artesanais ou Tecnológicos. Não importa: gostamos de diversidade e de quem está aqui para agregar.

Porque GENTE É O QUE SOMA.

Buscamos uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Mobile Flutter Sênior para atuar em um ecossistema de aplicativos digitais iOS e Android, com múltiplos produtos, marcas e integrações, garantindo qualidade técnica, performance e experiência consistente para o usuário final.

Você precisa ser uma pessoa apaixonada por tecnologia, com forte perfil analítico, colaborativo e orientado a aprendizado contínuo, capaz de atuar em arquitetura, sustentação e evolução de apps em produção em um ambiente ágil.

QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicativos móveis em Flutter (Dart) para Android e iOS, desde a concepção até a publicação e manutenção, utilizando boas práticas de arquitetura em camadas, Clean Architecture e princípios SOLID.
  • Implementar telas, fluxos e componentes com atenção a UX, performance e estabilidade, incluindo composição de UIs complexas e widgets customizados.
  • Integrar os apps com APIs REST e serviços de terceiros, garantindo autenticação, tratamento robusto de erros e boa experiência em cenários offline/intermitentes.
  • Atuar na sustentação dos aplicativos: correção de bugs, investigação com logs e Crashlytics, análise de performance e prevenção de regressões.
  • Escrever e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de widgets), garantindo cobertura mínima em fluxos críticos de negócio e UI.
  • Participar de code reviews, refinamentos, estimativas e cerimônias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), contribuindo para decisões técnicas e de produto.
  • Colaborar com times de back-end, produto e design na definição de contratos de API, integrações, Design System e experiências consistentes entre plataformas.
  • Apoiar e evoluir a observabilidade dos apps (Crashlytics, Analytics, Feature Flags, Remote Config) e a experimentação via testes A/B.
  • Contribuir com documentação técnica, boas práticas de desenvolvimento e, quando necessário, participação em etapas técnicas de seleção (entrevistas e avaliações).

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Experiência sólida com Flutter e Dart em produção, incluindo publicação e manutenção de apps em Android e iOS.
  • Forte domínio de recursos modernos da linguagem Dart e programação assíncrona (Futures, Streams, async/await).
  • Experiência prática com arquitetura em camadas, Clean Architecture, separação de responsabilidades e gerenciamento de estado com GetX (lifecycle, .obs, Obx, GetBuilder).
  • Vivência com testes unitários e testes de widgets em Flutter, aplicados a lógica de negócio e componentes de UI.
  • Experiência consumindo APIs REST e integrando com serviços externos, incluindo tratamento de erros e lógica de autenticação.
  • Conhecimento de Git (Bitbucket ou equivalentes), fluxos de pull request e práticas de code review.
  • Vivência com ferramentas da Firebase Suite: Crashlytics, Analytics, Performance, Remote Config e Cloud Messaging.
  • Experiência com CI/CD para mobile/Flutter (ex.: CodeMagic, pipelines de integração e entrega contínua).
  • Noções sólidas de qualidade de código: organização, tratamento de erros, logging estruturado e atenção à performance.
  • +5 anos de experiência prática com Flutter/Dart

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência com múltiplas marcas / white-label apps, mantendo configurações distintas em um ecossistema compartilhado de packages.
  • Vivência com packages interconectados, modularização e gestão de dependências locais (path-based dependencies) e overrides.
  • Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização e animações com Lottie.
  • Experiência com Analytics (AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Insider) e Deep Linking (App Links, Universal Links, URL schemes).
  • Experiência com WebViews (InAppWebView customizada, WebView Flutter) e Push Notifications (Firebase Messaging, Flutter Local Notifications).

Informações adicionais

NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:
Além de trabalhar no maior grupo de moda do Brasil, focado em impulsionar talentos e especializado em fazer gigante, por aqui você também ganha:

Vale Refeição ou Refeitório;

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (apólice coletiva opcional);

Gympass;

Day-off no seu aniversário para você curtir muito;

Formato híbrido, para você trabalhar de onde quiser;

Até 50% de desconto nas nossas marcas;

PLR, de acordo com a nossa política;

Vagas de estacionamento e van no fim do dia, para te levar até o metrô mais próximo;

Cursos, palestras e Trilhas de Desenvolvimento, ao vivo e na nossa plataforma de conteúdo;

Avaliação de desempenho;

Muita visibilidade e exposição positiva, pra você conseguir se conectar com todo mundo sem muita hierarquia.

GRUPO SOMA agora É AZZAS 2154 FASHION & LIFESTYLE

Impulsionar o poder criativo da moda brasileira para o mundo

Por aqui, acreditamos no poder das ideias, na força da colaboração e na beleza da diversidade. Valorizamos quem faz, quem pensa diferente, quem aprende todos os dias e quem topa evoluir junto.

title: Investor Pleno/Sênior I Rio de Janeiro
description:
Sobre nós

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade


Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP, você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente. O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

Saiba mais sobre nosso dia a dia no Instagram e no LinkedIn.

Confira nossas avaliações no Glassdoor.

O Que Procuramos


Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset alllocation, enquadramento e inteligência de base;
  • Morar no Rio de Janeiro, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;
  • Ter pelo menos CEA ou CFP;

Diferenciais:

  • CAIA, CFA, CGA, CGE ou CFG;

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;

  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto as áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

  • Obs.: a contratação é CLT e presencial no Rio de Janeiro.

Benefícios:

Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • Plano odontológico
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Zenklub
  • Seguro de Vida
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)
  • Vale Transporte
  • New Value (clube de benefícios)
  • Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Auxílio Creche

Vida Financeira

  • Fundos de Investimentos Exclusivos
  • Assessoria de Investimentos
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.)

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.

Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

title: Senior Front-End and System Engineer
description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical depth, collaboration, and systems thinking shape the future of subsea developments?
 

Would you bring the curiosity, adaptability, and engineering mindset needed to solve complex challenges in early-phase offshore projects?
 

Join our Subsea & Surface Pressure Systems Team

Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market-leading business segments. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward Making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
 

Partner with the best

As a Front-End Subsea Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping early-phase subsea developments. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, support customer engagements, and contribute to concept definition, system architecture, and technical evaluations that guide major offshore projects.
 

As a Senior Front-End and System Engineer - Tendering & FEED, you will be responsible for:

  • Developing subsea field architectures, system layouts, and optimization studies from concept through FEED and into execution.
  • Defining and preparing functional specifications for subsea system components such as trees, controls, manifolds, wellhead connections, and flowlines.
  • Providing system design input for subsea project proposals, equipment packages, and concept definition activities.
  • Supporting R&D initiatives, technology development, and design reviews.


Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have Bachelor's (Engineering, or relevant subject)
  • Have 7+ years of experience with engineering processes, methods, and project execution practices
  • Have knowledge of the Subsea Systems Engineering lifecycle, including NPI, tendering, project engineering, SIT, commissioning, and operations.
  • Have availability to travel internationally for project needs or short-term assignments.


Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - from 7am-4pm
  • Location: RETIC, Ilha do Fundão, Rio de Janeiro.


Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
 

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits
About Us: We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
Join Us: Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you Let's come together and take energy forward.
